formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Once anyone submits the signature, the vault (0x8BcD…3703) sets the allowance of spender over owner's KPK_USDC_LL vault shares to exactly value. This replaces any earlier allowance and does not add to it.
The allowance has no expiry. The deadline only limits when the signature can be submitted (ERC2612ExpiredSignature if block.timestamp > deadline).
The owner's permit nonce is used up, so any other pending permit signed with the same nonce becomes invalid.

With the allowance, spender can transferFrom the owner's shares, or call redeem/withdraw with owner set to the signer, which burns the shares and sends the USDC to any receiver spender picks. A value of 2^256-1 is never reduced when spent.
formats.shown: "Approve {value} KPK_USDC_LL for {spender} until {deadline}". The fields show the owner, the spender, the allowance (in share decimals, with "Unlimited" at max uint), the signature deadline as a date, and the nonce.

findings.title: Permit interpolatedIntent says 'until {deadline}', which suggests the allowance expires, but it never does.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json interpolatedIntent "Approve {value} for {spender} until {deadline}". ERC20PermitUpgradeable.permit: `if (block.timestamp > deadline) revert ERC2612ExpiredSignature(deadline);` then `_approve(owner, spender, value);`. The deadline only limits when the signature can be submitted, and the allowance set by _approve has no expiry. Case 3 screen: "Approve Unlimited KPK_USDC_LL for 0x5619… until 2030-01-01".
findings.fix: Change to "Approve {spender} to spend {value} (signature valid until {deadline})", or drop the deadline from the interpolated intent. The 'Signature deadline' field already shows it.

findings.title: Permit always shows the raw nonce, which tells a normal signer nothing.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json field `#.nonce` label 'Nonce', format raw, visible always. Cases 0-3 show 'Nonce: 7/8/0'.
findings.fix: Set the nonce field to visible: never, or leave it out.
